video_title: Wemby, Spurs Under More Pressure Than Brunson, Knicks??

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Jalen Brunson's career-defining moment
quotes.excerpt: I think this is a big stepping stone for him as far as taking his career to that next level.
quotes.quote: It is a lot added to his name as far as when you speak on his game and his achievements throughout his career. So I think this is a big stepping stone for him as far as taking his career to that next level, increasing the accolades that come along with his name in this game. There was a lot of negativity as far as is he a winning player? Can he help the team get over that hump, become a championship type player? So I think this is the opportunity to do that, and I would say he is to me the guy that stands out the most as far as taking that next jump.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Knicks' championship expectations
quotes.excerpt: It's the Knicks. Their expectations are we're comparing him to the greats in the New York Knicks history.
quotes.quote: It's hard to pick someone on the Spurs, right? Just because they're here so early. They've blown out all expectations. It's even hard to pick Jalen Brunson because, again, there's all the questions: can the small guy lead your team to a championship? It's the Knicks. Their expectations are we're comparing him to the greats in the New York Knicks history and is he the best player of all time. He's got a chance to cement that in this series and in this final. Maybe him, maybe Mike Brown. Can he beat this young team? I can't see it being anybody on San Antonio, although I do think they're favored to win it.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the pressure to win for both teams
quotes.excerpt: I think both teams are in a situation where we didn't really expect them to be here this fast.
quotes.quote: I think both teams are in a situation where we didn't really expect them to be here this fast. You can make a case for some of the Knicks guys because you bring Jalen Brunson into that fold to compete for a championship. You bring Jalen Brunson in, Mike Brown. You put all those pieces together to finally put you in that position and I didn't realize it was going to be this early. Same case with San Antonio. So is it pressure on anybody? I don't know, but I'm sure legacies and reputations will change after this once it's all said and done.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on the pressure facing Mike Brown
quotes.excerpt: I do think Mike Brown just logically has to have pressure on him because he went out there and said we got to win a championship.
quotes.quote: I do think Mike Brown just logically has to have pressure on him because he went out there and said we got to win a championship. You fire your coach that got you to the conference finals. I don't think there should be a single ounce of pressure on Mike Brown, but if you're asking who's under the most, it feels like he would be the only one that would feel some sort of pressure because you don't know what owners are going to do, because they can do whatever they want.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the pressure to bring home a championship
quotes.excerpt: I don't think it's pressure on him to keep his job. I think it's pressure on him to bring it home.
quotes.quote: I don't think it's pressure on him to keep his job. I think it's pressure on him to bring it home.
